name: Commercial Spaces
title: Commercial Pixel Lighting & Installation
metaDescription: Music-reactive pixel lighting kits for retail plazas, restaurants, hotels, venues and property managers across Canada. Mega trees and rooflines, installed.
h1: Commercial lighting that reacts to the room.
intro: Restaurants, patios, retail plazas, hotels, venues and managed properties use Resonate kits to turn an ordinary frontage into the reason people stop, look and come in. The display listens to your music and moves with it, every night, without staff touching anything.

sections.heading: Why commercial operators choose pixel lighting
sections.body: String lights are static and seasonal. Addressable 12 V WS2811 pixels can show any colour and any pattern, and the whole look changes from a phone. A patio can run a slow warm Candlelight theme on a Tuesday and a music-reactive Power look for a Saturday event, on the same hardware with no ladders.

sections.heading: Built to run itself
sections.body: The controller turns the lights on at dusk and off at close on the days you choose, and can start a playlist that steps through themes and saved looks. Staff connect to the controller's own Wi-Fi from any phone, with no app store and no account, and change the look in two taps.

sections.heading: Permanent or seasonal
sections.body: Rooflines can stay up year-round in brand colours and switch to holiday themes in December. Mega trees and wrapped trees can be permanent features or seasonal installs, with takedown and storage handled by our care service.

faqs.question: Does the lighting need our sound system?
faqs.answer: No. The USB microphone on the controller listens to whatever is playing on your existing speakers. The controller can also play MP3s from a USB stick through a sound system if you want it to.

faqs.question: Can we turn the reactivity off?
faqs.answer: Yes. Steady looks and themes run without music, and themes only pulse with the music when React to music is switched on.

faqs.question: What about winter?
faqs.answer: We install for your local climate, with sealed connections, cold-flexible cable, wind-rated anchoring and enclosures above the snow line. See the notes for your city on the locations page.

name: Business Improvement Areas
title: BIA Holiday & Streetscape Pixel Lighting
metaDescription: Synchronised pixel lighting for BIAs, BIDs, BIZ zones and SDCs across Canada: rooflines over several storefronts, mega trees and arches, lifetime software.
h1: Give your main street a show worth the trip.
intro: Business Improvement Areas compete for foot traffic with malls and online shopping. A synchronised, music-reactive light show along the main street, with rooflines across several storefronts, mega trees in the square and an arch at the entrance, creates an event people plan around and merchants benefit from.
audiences: BIAs, BIDs, BIZ zones and SDCs

sections.heading: One show across many storefronts
sections.body: Every prop on the street runs from one control system, with additional pixel controllers as the layout grows. Each roofline can run its own look for its merchant, and the whole street can join one theme for a launch night, a parade or a festival.

sections.heading: Designed around your budget cycle
sections.body: We scope BIA projects in phases, often a mega tree and a few rooflines in year one, then more frontages each year. Every phase uses the same control platform and software, so nothing is replaced as the display grows. Itemised quotes are ready for board approval.

sections.heading: Serviced for the season
sections.body: Care visits cover pre-season checks, theme and playlist changes, pixel repairs and takedown and storage for seasonal props. Your coordinator runs day-to-day control from a phone.

faqs.question: Who controls the display?
faqs.answer: Your coordinator or a delegate, from any phone on the controller's Lightshow Wi-Fi, signed in with the admin password. Schedules and playlists run on their own.

faqs.question: Can merchants have their own colours?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each roofline is its own prop in the Light Show app, so a storefront can run its own look, and every prop can join the same theme for street-wide events.

faqs.question: Do you work with municipal electrical?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design power distribution around available circuits and coordinate with your municipality's electrical contractor where needed; electrical work by others is billed at cost.

name: Municipalities
title: Municipal Holiday Lighting Programs
metaDescription: Public-space pixel lighting programs for Canadian municipalities: mega trees, wrapped trees, rooflines and arch walkways, scheduled from one phone app.
h1: Public light shows, built for public spaces.
intro: Town squares, parks, waterfronts and civic buildings are where a community gathers in winter. A Resonate municipal program puts synchronised mega trees, wrapped trees and an arch walkway at the centre of it, scheduled and run from one system.

sections.heading: Scheduled and dependable
sections.body: The show turns on and off at set times on chosen days and can run a looping playlist of themes and looks all season. For a tree-lighting ceremony, switch to a music look and let the microphone follow the band.

sections.heading: Hardware chosen for public sites
sections.body: 12 V WS2811 pixels, sealed connections, lockable enclosures, and props anchored for snow and wind loads, placed with sightlines and pedestrian safety in mind.

sections.heading: Procurement-friendly scoping
sections.body: Itemised scopes with product descriptions, power requirements, installation crew-days and travel, suitable for council reports and procurement. Starting prices are published and every project is confirmed after a site review.

faqs.question: Can the show be timed to a tree-lighting ceremony?
faqs.answer: Yes. Switch the props on from a phone at the moment of the ceremony, then let the nightly schedule and playlist take over.

faqs.question: How are software updates handled?
faqs.answer: Updates to the Light Show software are included for the life of the kit and are applied during care visits.

faqs.question: Do you provide documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each project is delivered with a prop map, power plan, controller port settings and a one-page operator guide.
